name: Tyler Oberquell
footer_note: Built and maintained by {name}. No trackers, no cookies.
site_description: Personal software projects by {name}: a roguelite game engine, an MLB season simulator, a multi-source Android weather app and a self-hosted home server dashboard.

pi-server.title: Pi Server
pi-server.short: A self-hosted control panel for my home network, running on a Raspberry Pi 5. Live hardware stats, network scanning, remote power control and push alerts.

diamondsim.title: DiamondSim
diamondsim.short: A desktop app that plays out the rest of an MLB season thousands of times and reports each team's playoff odds.

raincheck.title: RainCheck
raincheck.short: A native Android weather app that queries several forecast providers at once and averages it out.

snake.title: Snake Gone Rogue
snake.short: Snake, rebuilt as a roguelite. Shop upgrades, run modifiers, a rising quota, and different apples.

benchmark.title: Human Benchmark Bot
benchmark.short: A browser automation tool that plays the Human Benchmark tests, driven from a small desktop control panel.

calculator.title: Scientific Calculator
calculator.short: A desktop scientific calculator with support for standard and advanced mathematical operations.
